svg.title: SIR epidemic: S, I, R
svg.desc: One SIR epidemic with an infection rate of 0.4 and a recovery rate of 0.1 (a basic reproduction number of 4): infections peak as the susceptible pool runs down, and most of the population ends up recovered. Line chart of S, I, R against t from 0 to 120: S from 19.618 to 990; I from 0.068365 to 405.94; R from 0 to 980.31. Computed as sir · ODE · RK4 · 2,400 steps · seed —.
